The [[List of first overall National Football League Draft picks|first player selected]] was [[Tucker Frederickson]], [[Running back|back]] from [[1964 Auburn Tigers football team|Auburn]], by the [[1965 New York Giants season|New York Giants]].{{cite news |url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=9VtYAAAAIBAJ&sjid=lvcDAAAAIBAJ&pg=7439%2C7360233 |newspaper=Spokane Daily Chronicle |agency=Associated Press |title=No. 1 picks |date=November 28, 1964 |page=8}} The draft was marked by the failure of the [[1965 St. Louis Cardinals (NFL) season|St. Louis Cardinals]] to sign quarterback [[Joe Namath]] of [[1964 Alabama Crimson Tide football team|Alabama]], who instead committed to the [[1965 New York Jets season|New York Jets]] of the rival [[American Football League]] for a record contract amount.
